title: Mystic Astronomers
description: Two figures in hooded robes sit at a wooden desk inside a stone study filled with framed celestial paintings. A large arched window reveals a vibrant night sky with a glowing multicolored planet, mountains, and stars.
prompt: A cozy stone-walled study filled with framed paintings of planets and moons on the walls. Two figures in ornate blue and purple hooded robes sit at a wooden desk covered with an open illuminated book, colorful mineral specimens, and glowing lanterns. Through a large arched window, a dramatic night landscape shows purple mountains under a massive glowing planet with swirling colorful patterns and bright stars. Magical herbs and lanterns hang on the walls, warm and cool lighting, detailed fantasy illustration.
